The '''''Valiant Damsel''''' was a [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] operated by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It was used by a group of [[operative]]s who helped to rescue the [[Black Curs]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Moorja/Legends|Moorja]].
